title: Convert a camelCase identifier to snake_case
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It validates ASCII letters and digits, breaks before a capital that follows a lowercase letter or digit or ends an acronym before a lowercase letter, and lowercases the result.
It converts snake_case to camelCase in a function named snake_to_camel, the reverse of the requested to_snake conversion.
Two substitutions split an acronym from a following word and split a lowercase letter or digit from the next capital, which gives every word break the brief specifies.
It never breaks after a digit, so to_snake("utf8Decode") returns "utf8decode" instead of "utf8_decode", although the pasted log claims that exact case passed.
